mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_sms_code(phone_cipher, code, expire_time, used) VALUES( #{phoneCipher,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{code,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{expireTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, IFNULL(#{used,jdbcType=TINYINT}, 0) )
mapper.select: SELECT id, phone_cipher, code, expire_time, used, create_time FROM user_sms_code WHERE phone_cipher = #{phoneCipher} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE user_sms_code SET used = 1 WHERE id = #{id}
